text: The tool did not confirm any loss on this asset, but it also did not confirm the absence of loss. The assessment is "insufficient evidence" because the required satellite data (e.g., Hansen GFC, JRC GFC2020) was not available for this asset. The tool explicitly states it *does not establish* whether tree-cover loss occurred, did not occur, or whether the asset complies with regulations. In other words, no conclusion can be drawn—no loss was detected, but that doesn’t prove no loss happened.
